entities.summary: Yemodish Bekele was a published author of thirteen books, including poetry, short stories, and a novella, and was the first Ethiopian woman to publish her own collection of short stories. A crime journalist, Yemedish was also the first woman to become the head editor for Polis Ena Ermijaw the newspaper of the Federal Police in Ethiopia.
